long_biography.plain_text:
Glove manufacturer Mark Robba funded a learning centre in the Raja Ampat village of Sauwandarek, designed by Indonesian architect Popo Danes. Built with local labour and traditional techniques, it opened in 2019. The centre was intended to offer conservation education, health advice and vocational training, with improved village waste management among its first planned programmes.

Practical instruction also features in Robba's industrial work. He led a team of sewing, quality and engineering specialists to train staff at India's Kwik Patch. The workshop helped the manufacturer develop technically demanding glove samples while introducing its staff to more consistent production methods.

Current manufacturing is explicitly an origin-sector fallback. Historical personal plant ownership and export-business materiality are established independently. Current business continuity and commissioner status do not prove retained private equity or reveal the full personal balance sheet.

Founder is the strongest current relationship alternative. Active technical work is positive evidence against assuming total retirement, but ownership, executive title and expertise are different claims. No current asset-specific beneficial stake or investment mandate could be established. The Unknown decision is substantive rather than based only on lack of net-worth figures.

Broad Self-made concerns the created industrial fortune. Specific launch capital remains unreported; neither father's consultancy employment nor a commercially obtained customer establishes inherited capital. A narrowed subtype is withheld.
Interview business launch in1992 and corporate establishment in1998 need not be the same event. Exact formation date is omitted from biographies. No personal fortune is equated with company turnover.

Indonesian citizenship is directly stated in2023 business reporting and corroborated in2020. Earlier American background remains true, but a second current nationality is not assumed; citizenship certificate and naturalisation date were unavailable.

Middle Christopher is corroborated independently. Exact birthday, birth month/year and birthplace are unverified. The reported age57 in2017 is not converted to a birth year. Consultant father's travel and New England holidays do not prove birthplace.
Mark Alexander Robba, the deceased Virginia resident, and Brisbane's Iona College Mark Robba are rejected namesakes. No mortality correction is justified.

Forbes-first and exact profile searches found event coverage only. All personal link types were searched: LinkedIn, Instagram, Personal Website, Facebook, Twitter/X, Youtube and TikTok. Supported Wikipedia, Forbes, Vimeo, Flickr, Trip Advisor, Zillow and Company Website were also checked. Only personal LinkedIn met verification criteria; company and interview channels are not personal accounts.

Official company domain is consistently identified but direct connection failed. It remains a candidate rather than a proposed functioning website. No former vessel website is substituted for a personal website.

The community centre opened; educational and waste-management programmes were described as intended. Their later implementation is not established and prose preserves this distinction. The contribution is durable even after the vessel sale.

Apparel manufacturing is the minimum active tag. The public contribution is narrative only, since the commercial education-provider tag excludes donors. Recreational yacht ownership and college sailing do not establish a defining competitive-sailing identity.
Source access notes distinguish full HTML, full relevant indexed sections, public post text and inaccessible video/profile routes. No social account is verified from a name match alone.
